scoring_justification: Cannot recompute loss from raw predictions; no per-row gold table available. Score structural properties of the validation loss curve and resonant amplitudes, plus the resonant detection criterion.

outputs.description: Per‑trajectory validation loss and predicted resonant amplitude A_sigma for 1000 validation trajectories. The hidden checker compares these values to gold reference values (with tolerances for stochastic training) and also verifies that all predicted_A_sigma are below 120°.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the numerical integration, model construction, training, and evaluation entirely from the method description. No pre‑generated data, pre‑trained model, or external data downloads are provided; the workflow is compute‑heavy but fully public.

steps.description: Structural checks on validation results CSV: resonant detection (A_sigma < 120°), amplitude accuracy relative to |180 - sigma_0|, loss curve shape, and basic sanity.
